# BCGov Crow - v0.7.4

## Release type

Patch release improving Crow Testing Agent guidance and documentation.

## Summary

This release makes testing status easier to understand, separates recurring manual QA scope from external
execution tracking, and adds safe draft-only work-item guidance for confirmed bugs and approved actionable
design smells.

## Highlights

- Status-first testing plan and scenario templates show automated coverage, manual QA scope, open decisions,
  and work-item candidates at a glance.
- Manual QA documentation records recurring scope, steps, expected results, and release triggers without
  pretending to track execution in the repository.
- Work-item candidates are stored locally as public-safe draft documents; external tracker search and ticket
  creation remain out of scope.

## Changes

- Added plain-language bug drafts with post-fix manual verification steps.
- Added design-smell drafts with behavior-change statements, verification criteria, and focused happy-path
  checks when needed.
- Added public-release redaction guidance for persisted work-item drafts.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed; generated `bcgov-crow-0.7.4` package contents.
- Archive inspection: pending final package build.
- Additional checks: version consistency and staged-file public-release review.

## Artifacts

- Archive: `bcgov-crow-0.7.4.zip`
- SHA-256 file: `bcgov-crow-0.7.4.zip.sha256`
- SHA-256: generated during packaging

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.7.4 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.7.4.zip --global --target copilot
```

## Compatibility and scope

Compatible patch release. Existing Crow Testing Agent workflows remain supported. Existing testing documents
are updated lazily when their feature is next touched.

## Upgrade notes

No migration is required. New work-item candidate drafts use `docs/testing/drafts/`; manual QA execution
continues to be tracked outside the repository.
